title: DFARS Clause Record
description: Structured representation of a single DFARS clause with contractor-relevant metadata.

slug.description: URL-safe slug derived from the clause number, e.g. '252-204-7012'.

title.description: Official short title of the clause.

description.description: Plain-English summary of the clause's purpose (2-4 sentences).

applicability.description: When this clause is included in solicitations or contracts.

keyRequirements.description: Bullet list of the contractor's primary obligations under this clause.

flowdown.description: Whether the clause must flow down to subcontractors.

relatedNist.description: NIST 800-171 controls referenced by or relevant to this clause (e.g. 'AC-3.1.1', '3.1.1').

relatedHubs.description: Cabrillo Club content hubs related to this clause (used for cross-linking).

searchTier.description: Search-volume tier — 'high' clauses see significant query volume in our SEO data.

faq.description: Contractor-grade FAQs answering common confusion points.

practicalExample.description: Optional — a real-world scenario showing how the clause applies.

whyItMatters.description: Optional — business-impact framing of why contractors should care.

complianceCost.description: Optional — typical implementation cost band or guidance.

complianceChecklist.description: Optional — actionable steps to comply with the clause.

crossReferences.description: Optional — related FAR/DFARS clauses that should be read alongside this one.

procurementGuidance.description: Optional — RFP-language guidance (typically for contracting officers).
